note: Starrating adds a 'starrating' field type (tiny int) + select widget + three formatters: starrating (icons via theme starrating_formatter and per-icon CSS libraries), starrating_value (raw number), starrating_value_rating (rate/max e.g. 8/10). Per-field setting max_value (1-10, default 10). Icon formatter settings: icon_type (17 sets incl. star, heart, fire...), icon_color (1-8), fill_blank. No admin config page, no routes/permissions/services/Drush; author-set rating, not end-user voting. Medium reads back a live field's max_value + icon_type; hard cases create a starrating field (max 5) and switch a field's formatter to the 8/10 text formatter, both verified against live field/display config. Fixtures namespaced field_srt_*. NOTE: deleting a FieldConfig on this site does not auto-remove its view-display component, so cleanup/reset scripts removeComponent explicitly.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal starrating module provide, and which three display formatters does it offer for its field (including the one that shows something like 8/10)?
evals.expected_output: It provides a 'starrating' field type (tiny integer) with a select widget and three formatters: starrating (renders icons like stars), starrating_value (the raw number), and starrating_value_rating (the value over the max, e.g. 8/10). It is an author-set rating, not end-user voting.

evals.prompt: How do you make a starrating field use a scale of 1-5 instead of the default, in Drupal?
evals.expected_output: Set the field's max_value setting (the 'Maximum rating value' select, 1-10, default 10) to 5 on the field instance's settings (field.field.<entity>.<bundle>.<field>.settings.max_value). The widget then offers 0-5.

evals.prompt: In the starrating module, how do you display the rating with heart icons instead of stars, and which formatter setting controls that?
evals.expected_output: Use the 'starrating' (icon) formatter and set its icon_type setting to 'heart' (17 icon sets are available: star, heart, fire, thumbsup, etc.). icon_color (1-8) and fill_blank are the other formatter settings.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a Star rating field named field_srt_known. What is its maximum rating value (the top of its scale)? Inspect the live field configuration.

On this Drupal site, the Article default display renders the field_srt_known Star rating field using the icon formatter. Which icon set (icon_type) is it configured to use? Inspect the live display configuration.
evals.expected_output: fire - in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_srt_known component (formatter starrating) has settings.icon_type = fire.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a Star rating field named field_srt_task to the Article content type using the starrating module, configured with a maximum rating value of 5. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a FieldStorageConfig (node, field_srt_task, type starrating) and a FieldConfig on node.article with settings.max_value = 5, e.g. via Field UI or the entity API.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a Star rating field field_srt_fmt that currently displays as icons. Change the Article default display so this field is shown as a numeric rating like 8/10 (the starrating text-rating formatter) instead of icons. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_srt_fmt component in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default to formatter type starrating_value_rating (the 'Star rating (e.g. 8/10)' formatter).
